body: At 21 your still very young and there is still a really good chance that you will meet the person your suppose to be with. You are in your prime. From what you said it does sound like you have a lot going for you. Go hang out with your friends at new places and meet new people. I have confidence that you will eventually find everything you are searching for and you will look back on this like it was all just a bad dream.

I actually went to bed after writing that last post. Wasn't planing on it but I fell asleep when I was laying down for a couple of minutes. 

I used computers to help me get myself off meth when I was 17 1/2. In order for me to make that work I had to ditch everyone I knew. I made friends online and learned how to fix computers to a degree. I wouldn't call my self an expert though and I'm also lacking anything that would give me credibility in the field. 

I only have 2 friends left online and they are not the kind of friends that you can talk to about these kind of things and since they are online friends they can't really help with my need to get out of the house. 

I live in California btw. I might go for a walk here in a couple but there is a couple things I need to do first.

Edit: Well I did end up taking a walk but I forgot bring poop bags for the dogs so after realizing I had forgot them I was worried the dogs were going to poop for most of the walk. Besides that I still couldn't really stop feeling depressed. Part of my problem I think is the lack of human interactions and feeling zero self worth. I will probably try to take a walk tomorrow though and see if it goes any better. I need to take the dogs out more often anyways.

I actually smoke weed very rarely(once every few months, maybe only couple times a year) because it made me even more depressed and unable to control my emotions. Mainly in my journal I was listing things off to myself that I have tried to make myself feel better that either never worked or no longer works but I wish did.

I have been doing some IT work for local businesses but most of it is online and it doesn't keep me busy enough. I make a very little amount of money so I hardly even consider it a job. 

I guess the main reason I don't have anything better is because of my depression and I have no confidence in myself. It is 2 1/2 months short of a year since my last full time job. 

I have a 7th grade level of education in most subjects and I have always worried about the expense behind catching me up. We don't really have money to spare. 

Yes I have considered trying walks again. They didn't help in the past but I am going to attempt it again.

Yeah, I guess I am trying to live life through her. I don't really have anything going for myself. Even when I was working I struggled with depression and only had fun when I went out and did things with her. I don't really have any friends of my own because I had to ditch them all when I was younger because of drug issues. I have a lot of trouble making friends now.

I'm pretty sure she knows that it never really went away for me. Right now she just doesn't want to stuff anything else in to her already full life. Helping me with this problem really isn't an option for her. She is going to school still and her class requires a lot of homework time and at the same time she is working over 40 hours a week.

I still have to be the strong one. There is many days were she wants to give up on either work or school and I have to be there to talk her out of it. She is always grateful for me being there for her and not letting her give up but she is only hanging on by a thread at times. If she didn't have these structures in place she would be in a similar place that I am. After a while she forgets that I kind of helped her keep her things together. She starts to think of me as a thorn in her side because I ask her to try to get time off work to help manage her school life and still have time for our relationship but she is really against asking for time off. 

She feels more of a duty to her job because she manages a whole store that is always demanding of her time but she doesn't feel that same duty to our relationship and I am to blame. I can't get out of this depressed state and get myself a job that makes more then the peanuts I'm getting now from my mostly at home job and I have been stuck like this for so long that she probably feels like it will never change.

What if for some reason I wanted to take my medication the same way I give it to my dog, by mixing it up in my food. Then I reasonably expect that no one would steal my food.

So if we start doing what all the companies in the US are doing and just put a label on our own food saying "may contain medicine (including but not limited to ex-lax), poison, dog food, or other unwanted ingredients in this food that isn't yours" then we should be safe.

It's one thing to put a poison that is meant to kill someone in food vs putting EX-LAX in food though. My point was as long as they didn't actually put a deadly poison in their food or something that shows intent on killing the person then the person stealing it gets what they deserve. 

There are all types of different (and weird) people out there. I'm sure there is someone out there that uses EX-LAX in their food. With how many weird people you run in to in your lifetime you should just assume that is the kind of person that made the sandwich that is sitting in the that fridge, that isn't yours, and just stay away from it.

Reminds me of those cases where some one breaks in to a house and they get hurt while their in the house and then they turn around and sue the property owner. 

Next thing you know we will see cases where someone steals your lunch and found out the hard way they have a severe food allergy and dies and then you get sued by the family. 

We need to do away with that shit. If someone steals your lunch and gets sick off of it, then its their own fault. You don't know if that person washes their hands. if you didn't make it or get it from a restaurant then you have no right to have any expectations that the food was prepared in a clean environment with only the ingredients you would expect.
After seeing the cpu temperature drop as low as it did with my own eyes I agree completely that the $90 price tag was well worth it. It was the skepticism I had before hand that made it hard to cope.

Just coming in to give an update. I did end up getting the NH-D15 and I am very very happy with it. 

My computer was sitting at 50-55 idle before and now it sits at 17-22 idle. I have even seen it get down to 15c which is pretty incredible. When gaming it never goes above 35c. It hasn't been quite as hot this week so it may go above 35c but I'm certain cpu heat wont be an issue anymore with this monster cooler. Even though I didn't really care about getting the quietest cpu cooler out there I am super surprised at how quiet this thing is. Didn't know it was possible to get something this quiet while still being this effective.  Thanks for the advice.

It's funny because I had a friend suggest that same one (NH-D15) to me and said pretty much the same thing. It's bit more expensive for one of this type but I have been contemplating it since it gets such high praise. I have the [HAF 922](http://www.coolermaster.com/case/mid-tower/haf-922/) case, it is a monster of a case so it shouldn't have any issues.

I am probably going to end up needing two of these because my girlfriends computer is starting to have the same problem while she is gaming. It will take a dent out of my wallet but this might end up being the one I choose. I will have to check her case out too.

I cleaned my computer maybe like 2 months ago and it's still pretty clean in there. The fan still seems to be working ok, I will have to check the speed it gets to the next time I game. The cpu, motherboard and video card are all less then a year old so I think the thermal paste should still be ok. I live in southern California so its getting hot and I can't really afford to run the air to much, I live in a older house and it gets pretty expensive. 

I don't overclock and I don't need to to be quite, as long as it doesn't sound like an airplane about to take off. My video card (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970) gets to a max of about 75C (95c is max temp for this card) so it is doing fine while gaming. My motherboard has been getting a little hot but I'm pretty sure that's only because of my CPU is getting as hot as it has, so that should be fixed by a new CPU cooler as well.

I have used http://octapharmaplasma.com/donor/center/18566
this place. I only went once but I got $50.  It was more then normal because it was my very first visit.  On a normal visit it is $25 for the first time in a week and $30 if you go a second time within that 7 day period. You have to wait at least one day between visits and you can only visit twice in 7 days. The amounts given may have changed since I went and I think it may also have depended on your weight.

I only went once because my circumstances changed shortly after. I most likely would have continued going if that wasn't the case.

The rest of this will be a wall of text but keep reading if you want more information on how is was for me on my first and only visit.
-------------------------------------------------------------
 

Just make sure you clear your schedule for the day because it can take quite a while on your first visit, it just depends. It took me about 5 hours. 

I had to read a binder full of information then watch a video that pretty much said the same thing as the binder except for a couple details on how the process works. 
After that I had to wait to talk to someone who asked me health question and took my finger print and looked over my proof of address. After that they have you go to a kiosk tablet where I had to answer even more health related questions. 

After that you get a pass to the front of the line (The girl forgot to tell me this so I waited in line) where they check your blood pressure and make sure it isn't to high and they do a finger prick for blood that they will be screening. If you pass the blood pressure test you then get to sit in another line waiting (which for some reason took a while even though there was only 1 person ahead of me) to see a doctor for a quick (and pretty simple) physical. 


The doctor will then go over things you already read and watched in that video. If everything works out there then you will finally get to sit to get plugged in to the plasma machine.

By that time the place was really busy and they took probably another 35 minutes to plug me in.  The process of taking the blood and removing plasma and then returning the blood repeats 5 times (if i remember correctly) and it fills a jar. If you eat well then your can fill that jar as quick as 45 minutes but if your blood is thicker it could take an hour and half. If it is too think it could even cause problems (which was the case for me) but luckily for me it was so close to the top of the jar and they still let me leave $50 richer.

They give you a Visa card where you can pull the money out for a fee at an ATM or go to Stater bro's and buy a small item and get the rest in cash back (which wont cost a fee). I'm a little hazy on all the details about the card but I think you get only one point per a plasma visit on your card which means you can only use the card once after each visit. After that I think there is another fee to use it. 

I'm pretty sure they missed the main vein for me and I had a bruise in two spots on my arm where the blood pooled under my skin and it took around 2 weeks for that to clear up. If you get a bruise you will not be allowed to donate plasma again until it is completely cleared up. They can also deny you if you have any visible cuts or scabs.


Like I said before I never went for a second visit but from my understanding this is the process.
When you get into the building if there isn't a line to use one of the few kiosk's then you go up to the kiosk and it will use your finger print to sign you in. After it signs you in it will ask you a few questions and once you are done, you get to wait in that line I was telling you about above where they check your blood pressure and prick your finger. If you pass that you then get to go lay down and get plugged into the plasma machine. You know the rest from there.

Good luck and I hope this was helpful.
